title: ononis serrata var. marmorata
intro: Ononis serrata var. marmorata, commonly known as Spotted Restharrow, is a plant species in the pea family, Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Spotted Restharrow are believed to be due to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant, although not extensively studied, may include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
